focus_question: Which independently sourced INSIDE/Collector's Edition artifacts have a demonstrated native means to consume a new foreground-derived value, rather than merely resembling a code or displaying a static token?
scope: Closed-corpus source-first typed-affordance audit. Presence of an original historical interface does not imply it accepts CE stickers. Negative gates apply to preserved source versions, not inaccessible old backend revisions. Prior experiment 413 decodes the CE page footer as 128 UNSOLVED, but the decoding is not itself a foreground readout.

native_artifacts.native_role: Functional three-direction sequence consumer at the 2016 bunker
native_artifacts.native_input_type: ordered U/L/R actions; known existing solution uses fourteen actions
native_artifacts.mapping_provenance: Archived 2020–2021 sleeve/lever discussion; candidate physical interpretation, not developer confirmation
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: The known bunker password has left and right commands. Neither a primary-only slash/dash readout nor the tail-only slash/dot readout can reproduce it without mixing sectors or adding a transform; separate direct-replay and 2023 brute-force tests already negative.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: A second native lever handler or an artifact-supplied order/subset connecting sticker sectors to the lever.

native_artifacts.native_role: Original developer website: a phrase typed in the ordinary subscription field was used by the special webpage-printing action to produce conditional PDF/image output
native_artifacts.native_input_type: Deciphered printer phrase placed in subscription field and consumed when invoking a site printer/print button; not a CE-specific accepting textbox
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: The Microsoft/Xbox contemporary account establishes a working prior printer-to-site PDF consumer; it does not describe a Collector's Edition instruction, and its posted date predates CE sticker release.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Original Playdead web source or a CE-specific response distinguishing sticker-derived input from previously solved printer credentials.
native_artifacts.usage_caveat: Do not conflate pressing the print button with submitting the newsletter form; contemporary Xbox account summarizes the visible field, later Game Detectives documentation specifies the print action.

native_artifacts.native_input_type: historically named printer credentials, not a CE nine/27/108-slot input
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: Four of four schemes marked obtained/applied; no observed fifth ordinary scheme in this status source.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Server code, original request/response, or a distinct post-shutdown interface.

native_artifacts.native_role: 22-underscore printed prompt appearing on two pages
native_artifacts.native_input_type: 22 visible placeholder positions, but no verified input control or POST handler in archived HTML
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: Each source displays 22 underscores but has no HTML form, input, select or maxlength. A displayed interface cannot validate a sticker-derived token.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Archived original live form or original server-side request/response.

native_artifacts.native_role: One 75-character plus-delimited ASCII island, with one 22-character field
native_artifacts.native_input_type: seven source fields of lengths 26/22/10/2/3/1/5; field meanings unlabeled
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: The 22-character candidate field itself is an existing *value*, not a receiver. Direct unsigned base36 integer is 111 bits, larger than conditional 108-bit foreground ceiling.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: A source-defined record schema or verified client/server use of a specific field.

native_artifacts.native_role: Nine-piece background artwork recognized as the static URL dat/534brn9653f9j8mmd
native_artifacts.native_input_type: URL/path, already a solved output, not a new foreground form
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: The exact URL was source-index-assisted historically, not a demonstrated blind 21-character foreground key. No native index mapping from foreground into this path is supplied by the page.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Original page saying how CE dash/slash/dot, A–I or 81/27 is used.

native_artifacts.native_role: Damaged JFIF/Exif-like image and independently decoded footer 128 UNSOLVED (Experiment 413); 128 provides a candidate image-size clue, not a CE-specific recovery key
native_artifacts.native_input_type: damaged media, no typed sticker key or input operation present in accessible source
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: The footer 128 UNSOLVED is a meaningful prior-stage clue, and JPEG dimensions 128..255 remain possible (Experiments 413–414); no source-fixed operation maps slash/dash/dot or A-I positions to damaged entropy bytes, pixel masks or an image consumer.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Byte-correct original image or repair parameters explicitly connecting the known 128 clue and CE marks to the JPEG corruption/registration.

native_artifacts.native_input_type: no choice or per-step input; nine HTTP redirect pages
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: Nine consecutive pages are fixed links and do not consume a nine-command CE output.

native_artifacts.native_role: Advertised clue-bearing cover with screens of previously seen ARG artifacts
native_artifacts.native_input_type: image panels with no supplied foreground sampling lattice or overlay alignment
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: Existing cover and comparison crops are perspective/blurred; no reliably exact pixel coordinate map from H108 to panel image.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Original print-ready cover art or explicit transformation cue with fixed coordinate reference.

native_artifacts.native_role: Early extracted game map with approximately fourteen marks, potentially existing secret-orb sites
native_artifacts.native_input_type: static image/scene; no demonstrated CE sticker input, native texture/UV transform not recovered
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: Contemporaneous July 2016 discussion already counted a possible 14th marker and proposed the large final orb, years before CE. No unexplained native marks remain independently established.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Exact game-build native SecretMap DDS and matching scene UVs; preregister matching to fourteen known orbs first.

native_artifacts.native_role: Switch printer yielded Joy-Con connection/disconnection actions
native_artifacts.native_input_type: platform-specific ordered controller actions already consumed during solved printer scheme
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: Proof that some codes are instructions does not specify which stickers to read or any CE-native controller sequence.

native_artifacts.native_role: Acorn plus generation 41 supplied a Game of Life construction
native_artifacts.native_input_type: explicit seed + generation parameter, already consumed in original printer branch
native_artifacts.strongest_negative: Known Playdead generation mechanism does not license applying arbitrary Life rules to CE slash/dash/dot cells.
native_artifacts.next_independent_evidence: Sticker-native seed name and generation/transform parameters.

derived_projection_types.provenance: hypothesis 456 primary-body selected by Q4 depth

derived_projection_types.produced_value_type: 9 slash/dash commands under restricted U4/U5, stable --/--/-/-
9 ternary depth addresses; no source-fixed map to U/L/R
108 symbol code over sector-specific alphabets; fully ordered readout not given

verdict: A January 2019 Xbox Wire firsthand publisher account verifies a real printer phrase -> website subscription input -> corrupted PDF-image pathway, and the original secret-ending lever is functionally demonstrated in-game. Neither is independently shown to accept Collector's Edition foreground. Other Terminal41 and CE surfaces inspected are static, missing original handlers/assets, or already consumed; count matching is not a typed receiver.
